notes: Clicked for credits every turn from T2 to T17, reaching 58 credits without installing a single breaker (Stargate, Aesop's Pawnshop, Apocalypse and Rigging Up stayed in the grip); on T11 re-ran Archives twice to see only Obokata Protocol (and declined it at 4 net damage with a 5-card grip). On T18 played Mad Dash into unrezzed Archives ice with no breakers and was flatlined by Mlinzi.

Facechecked HQ with 2 credits on T1 and R&D with 0 credits on T2, then from T10 to T26 ran an empty Archives almost every turn and took a Trickster Taka tag each turn only to pay 2 credits and a click to remove it. With 20-39 credits and Paperclip/Black Orchestra available it never contested Server 1 while the Corp, often on 1 credit, installed and advanced Cyberdex Sandbox (T21-22) and Offworld Office (T24-27), and also left a 6-card HQ unrun from T9 to T14.

Burned Stimhack (and a core damage) on T1 for a single R&D access, then ended T1 on 1 credit. On T2 it facechecked unrezzed R&D ice with 1 credit and a 3-card grip against a Corp on 8 credits, and Anansi flatlined it.

Won with solid HQ/R&D pressure from T10, but early on it ran into ice with no breaker installed (HQ T2, R&D T4 into Hagen, Server 2 T7) and used Stimhack plus a core damage on an empty Archives on T4. Its Archives runs to farm Yusuf counters and its Clone Chip recovery of Black Orchestra were sensible.

Fast, coherent win: trashed both Regolith Mining Licenses (T2, T6), hammered HQ through Konjin and took Obokata at 4 net damage when it was worth it. The only oddities were Pinhole Threading on Archives with nothing to hit (T8) and a repeat HQ run seeing Chiyashi again (T9).

Never installed a breaker all game and won only because the Corp decked. On T3-T5 it ran an open HQ four times a turn, re-seeing the same cards; it left Rashida Jaheem untrashed in HQ (T5) and in Server 2 (T6) despite having the credits, and bounced off Gatekeeper with no breaker on Servers 1, 3 and 4 (T2, T8, T9) while GFI was scored from Server 3 on T11.

Good tempo win: Hippo plus Paperclip through Border Control for Project Atlas (T6) and well-timed runs on R&D and Server 2. The mistakes were a T1 facecheck on HQ at 1 credit (Mausolus took Stargate and gave a tag), an early Labor Rights on T2 and a redundant second Paperclip install on T8.

From T5 to T12 it spent essentially every click running into the same rezzed Border Control on Server 1, R&D and Server 3 with no barrier breaker, giving the Corp a credit each time (Corp went from 3 to 31 credits). It never drew or installed anything after T4, and the Corp scored Obokata, Philotic Entanglement and Nisei MK II unopposed.

Unguarded R&D runs got it to 6 points by T5, but it never installed a card from its 5-card grip and never contested Server 1, where the Corp scored Megaprix twice, Elivagar and Vitruvius (T2-T6). At 6 points needing one steal, it clicked for credits all of T6-T7 while GFI was installed and advanced, then bounced off Magnet on T8 with no breaker.

Took the Megaprix from Archives, used Mad Dash plus Hippo well for Megaprix on T9, and closed by tanking Loki/Drafter for Luminal and then GFI on T12. It was passive on T6-T7 (eight clicks for credits while the Corp sat on 2-6 credits with soft HQ/R&D) and installed a second Hippo on T10 without using it.

Won via R&D accesses and Project Vacheron, but R&D was unguarded all game and from T8 to T13 it usually ran it only once or twice a turn and clicked for credits instead. It never trashed the Marilyn Campaigns in naked Servers 1 and 2 (T8-T9), which let the Corp reach 67 credits, and it took the News Team tags from Archives on T7 and then spent 3 clicks clearing them.

Every turn it ran R&D first into Excalibur, which locked it out of further runs, while the Corp advanced and scored from Server 1 behind a Thimblerig its Paperclip could break: Nisei MK II on T3 and T5 and Obokata Protocol on T9 (advanced twice on T8). It also paid Scarcity-inflated costs for Daily Casts (5, T7) and a second Liberated Account (8, T8).

Unguarded R&D runs four times a turn found Hyperloop, The Future is Now, Megaprix and Vacheron, which was strong. But it sat on 2 credits all game, never trashed Rashida in naked Server 2 (T2), and spent T5's late runs on R&D instead of the naked Server 3 where False Lead had just been installed (scored T6).

After a good T2 HQ steal it clicked for credits on almost every click from T4 to T13, reaching 40 credits while the Corp built Commercial Bankers Group, PAD Campaign, Rashida, Jeeves and Mumba Temple in naked remotes, none of which it trashed. On T14 it ran twice into IP Block on Server 13 with no breaker, and Bellona scored next turn.

It left 8 Hard-Hitting News tags largely uncleared, reinstalled Liberated Account on T7 while heavily tagged and lost it again on T8-T9, and spent most of the game on 0-4 credits. It did not contest Server 1 while Bellona was installed and advanced (T14-15, T17-18), and won only through steady Paperclip R&D runs on T15 and T19.

It clicked for credits on every click from T1 to T11 (51 credits, nothing installed, no runs) while the Corp scored GFI on T7 and T10 from Server 1 behind unrezzed ice. On T12 it finally played Stimhack into an unrezzed Gatekeeper with no breaker, then let Efficiency Committee score on T13.

Paperclip HQ runs stole two Nisei MK IIs and a late R&D access won with Obokata. But from T12 to T17 it ran Slot Machine unbroken every turn (losing 3 credits and feeding the Corp 3), re-ran Archives each turn to re-access Cyberdex Virus Suite, and clicked for credits only to lose them, sitting at 0-2 credits.

It clicked for credits nearly every turn from T6 to T13 (reaching 43 credits) and ignored Server 1, which it could break with Black Orchestra, while Cyberdex Sandbox (T11-12) and Luminal (T13-14) were advanced and scored. On T15-T16 it made 7 identical runs into two unbreakable Ansel 1.0s that each prevented stealing GFI, losing MKUltra over and over, and GFI scored on T17.

A sensible plan (Inject/Clone Chip rebuilding Paperclip and Black Orchestra, R&D/HQ pressure, Archives steals) won on T20, but it ran poor all game. It facechecked with almost no credits (HQ at 1 credit on T3, Server 3 via Dirty Laundry on T10, Hagen on Server 5 at 0 credits on T19) and re-ran an empty Archives on T15-T17.

From T7 to T15 it clicked for credits every turn up to 54 credits, never ran, never trashed the three Commercial Bankers Groups (two in naked remotes), and never installed breakers beyond MKUltra. Project Atlas (T12), Project Atlas (T14) and GFI (T16) were all advanced in Server 4 without a single contest.
